status: provisional illustration only; not a validated throughput estimate
user_approval: Illustrative calculation using the local tram feed and historical cabin capacity; 2026-11-12
service_day_definition: GTFS service date: includes departures after midnight represented as 24:00 or later; not a midnight-to-midnight count.

crossing.queens_connection: No direct tram crossing to Queens; not a zero capacity for all island-to-Queens modes.

metric: scheduled passenger places under full occupancy

trip_count.warning: Local feed service patterns and stop-to-stop times require independent verification; service-day counts include five departures after midnight per direction.

passengers_per_cabin.source_description: RIOC-attributed modernization release: 109 passengers plus one attendant per cabin.
passengers_per_cabin.warning: This historical specification has not been independently confirmed for October 2026.

assumptions_and_sources.full_occupancy: ASSUMPTION: every scheduled trip is operated and loaded to 109 passengers; no closures, service disruptions or capacity restrictions.

result.formula: 109 scheduled trips per direction x 109 passengers per trip

interpretation: These are modeled passenger places, not observed passengers, demand, unique people or guaranteed operating capacity.
The combined figure counts directional trips, not people making round trips.
The count uses a GTFS service day rather than midnight-to-midnight and should not be directly combined with figures based on a different day definition.
The 109-passenger assumption excludes the attendant and may not apply during restrictions or to the selected date.
Do not use the illustration as a validated scenario baseline until the schedule and cabin capacity are verified.
